title: Understanding Annotator Safety Policy with Interpretability
summary:
Safety policies define what constitutes safe and unsafe AI outputs, guiding data annotation and model development. However, annotation disagreement is pervasive and can stem from multiple sources such as operational failures (annotators misunderstand or misexecute the task), policy ambiguity (policy wording leaves room for interpretation), or value pluralism (different annotators hold different perspectives on safety). Distinguishing these sources matters. For example, operational failures call for quality control, ambiguity calls for policy clarification, and pluralism calls for deliberation about incorporating diverse perspectives. Yet understanding why annotators disagree is difficult. Directly asking annotators for their reasoning is costly, substantially increasing annotation burden, and can be unreliable for both human and LLM annotators as self-reported reasoning often fails to reflect actual decision processes.
  We introduce Annotator Policy Models (APMs), interpretable models that learn annotators' internal safety policies from labeling behavior alone, making annotator reasoning visible and comparable without additional annotation effort. We validate that APMs accurately model annotator safety policy (>80% accuracy), faithfully predict responses to counterfactual edits, and recover known policy differences in controlled settings. Applying APMs to LLM and human annotations, we demonstrate two core applications: (1) surfacing policy ambiguity by revealing how annotators interpret safety instructions differently, and (2) surfacing value pluralism by uncovering systematic differences in safety priorities across demographic groups. Together, these capabilities support more targeted, transparent, and inclusive safety policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出注释者策略模型（APMs），从标注行为中学习注释者的内部安全策略，无需额外标注成本即可揭示注释分歧的根源，支持更透明、更具包容性的AI安全政策设计。
AI.motivation: 安全政策标注中的分歧来源复杂（操作失误、政策模糊、价值多元），但现有方法难以有效区分这些来源，直接询问注释者成本高且不可靠。
AI.method: 提出注释者策略模型（APMs），仅从标注行为数据中学习注释者内在的安全策略，生成可解释的策略表示，无需额外标注工作。
AI.result: APM在建模注释者安全策略上准确率>80%，能忠实预测反事实编辑下的响应，并在受控设置中恢复已知策略差异。
AI.conclusion: APMs能有效揭示政策模糊性（注释者如何以不同方式解读安全指令）和价值多元性（不同人口群体的安全优先级系统性差异），支持更精准、透明和包容的安全政策设计。
idea_en: Annotator Policy Models (APMs): Interpretable models that learn annotators' internal safety policies solely from labeling behavior, making annotator reasoning visible and comparable without additional annotation effort.
A method to distinguish sources of annotation disagreement (operational failures, policy ambiguity, value pluralism) by analyzing learned policy models rather than relying on self-reported reasoning.
Counterfactual edit prediction: Using APMs to faithfully predict how annotator decisions would change under modified safety policies, enabling policy impact assessment.
Policy ambiguity surfacing technique: Revealing how different annotators interpret identical safety instructions differently through comparative analysis of learned policy models.
Value pluralism detection across demographic groups: Uncovering systematic differences in safety priorities by comparing APMs learned from different demographic subsets.
A transparent safety policy design framework that uses APMs to identify where policy clarification vs. value deliberation is needed, supporting more inclusive AI alignment.
idea_ch: 注释者策略模型（APMs）：一种可解释模型，仅从标注行为中学习注释者的内部安全策略，无需额外标注成本即可揭示和比较注释者的推理过程。
注释分歧根源区分方法：通过学习到的策略模型来分析分歧来源（操作失误、政策模糊、价值多元），替代传统的自我报告推理方式，降低成本并提高可靠性。
反事实编辑预测技术：利用APMs预测在修改安全政策后注释者决策的变化情况，支持政策影响的预先评估。
政策模糊性揭示技术：通过对比分析不同注释者学到的策略模型，揭示他们对相同安全指令的不同解读方式。
跨人口群体价值多元性检测：通过比较不同人口统计学子集上训练的APMs，发现安全优先级方面的系统性差异。
透明安全政策设计框架：利用APMs识别哪些分歧需要政策澄清、哪些需要通过价值协商来解决，支持更具包容性的AI对齐方法。

title: ZAYA1-8B Technical Report
summary: We present ZAYA1-8B, a reasoning-focused mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 700M active and 8B total parameters, built on Zyphra's MoE++ architecture. ZAYA1-8B's core pretraining, midtraining, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) were performed on a full-stack AMD compute, networking, and software platform. With under 1B active parameters, ZAYA1-8B matches or exceeds DeepSeek-R1-0528 on several challenging mathematics and coding benchmarks, and remains competitive with substantially larger open-weight reasoning models. ZAYA1-8B was trained from scratch for reasoning, with reasoning data included from pretraining onward using an answer-preserving trimming scheme. Post-training uses a four-stage RL cascade: reasoning warmup on math and puzzles; a 400-task RLVE-Gym curriculum; math and code RL with test-time compute traces and synthetic code environments built from competitive-programming references; and behavioral RL for chat and instruction following. We also introduce Markovian RSA, a test-time compute method that recursively aggregates parallel reasoning traces while carrying forward only bounded-length reasoning tails between rounds. In TTC evaluation, Markovian RSA raises ZAYA1-8B to 91.9\% on AIME'25 and 89.6\% on HMMT'25 while carrying forward only a 4K-token tail, narrowing the gap to much larger reasoning models including Gemini-2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.2, and GPT-5-High.

AI.tldr: ZAYA1-8B是一个700M激活参数/8B总参数的推理聚焦混合专家模型，采用MoE++架构，在AMD平台上全栈训练。在数学和编程基准上匹配或超越DeepSeek-R1-0528，并提出Markovian RSA测试时计算方法，可递归聚合并行推理轨迹，仅携带4K token尾部即可达到AIME'25 91.9%和HMMT'25 89.6%的性能。
AI.motivation: 开发一个参数高效但推理能力强大的MoE模型，证明在有限计算资源下也能实现顶尖推理性能。同时探索更高效的测试时计算方法，通过递归聚合并行推理轨迹来提升模型的复杂推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 采用MoE++架构，700M活跃/8B总参数；2) 全栈AMD平台预训练、中训练和SFT；3) 自预训练起就引入推理数据，采用答案保留裁剪方案；4) 四阶段RL级联：推理热身、400任务RLVE-Gym课程、数学代码RL（含测试时计算轨迹和合成代码环境）、行为RL；5) 提出Markovian RSA测试时计算方法，递归聚合并行推理轨迹，仅携带有界长度推理尾部。
AI.result: 在多个数学和编程基准上匹配或超越DeepSeek-R1-0528；Markovian RSA将ZAYA1-8B提升至AIME'25 91.9%和HMMT'25 89.6%，仅携带4K token尾部，缩小了与Gemini-2.5 Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5-High等更大模型的差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的训练流程和创新的测试时计算方法，小参数MoE模型也能在推理任务上达到与大型模型竞争的水平。Markovian RSA作为一种高效测试时计算范式，在保持低计算开销的同时显著提升了推理性能。
idea_en: A reasoning-focused Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model architecture (ZAYA1-8B) with 700M active and 8B total parameters using MoE++ design, achieving competitive performance against models orders of magnitude larger.

Answer-preserving trimming scheme for reasoning data during pretraining, which selectively trims non-essential content while preserving the answer to maintain reasoning data quality from the earliest training stages.

Four-stage reinforcement learning cascade for reasoning model post-training: (1) reasoning warmup on math and puzzles, (2) 400-task RLVE-Gym curriculum, (3) math and code RL with test-time compute traces and synthetic code environments built from competitive-programming references, and (4) behavioral RL for chat and instruction following.

Markovian Recursive Self-Aggregation (RSA) - a test-time compute method that recursively aggregates parallel reasoning traces while carrying forward only bounded-length reasoning tails between rounds, achieving significant performance gains with minimal memory overhead.
Test-time compute system that carries forward only a 4K-token tail between aggregation rounds in Markovian RSA, enabling efficient multi-round reasoning improvement.
Synthetic code environment construction method based on competitive-programming references for reinforcement learning training of reasoning models.
idea_ch: 一种基于MoE++架构的推理聚焦混合专家模型（ZAYA1-8B），以700M活跃参数/8B总参数实现与超大规模模型竞争的性能。
答案保留裁剪方案（Answer-preserving trimming scheme），在预训练阶段选择性裁剪非必要内容同时保留答案，确保推理数据质量。
四阶段强化学习级联训练方法：数学谜题推理热身、400任务RLVE-Gym课程、基于测试时计算轨迹和竞赛编程合成代码环境的数学代码RL、以及聊天指令遵循的行为RL。
马尔可夫递归自聚合（Markovian RSA）测试时计算方法，递归聚合并行推理轨迹，轮次间仅携带有界长度的推理尾部，以极低内存开销显著提升推理性能。
基于仅4K token推理尾部的测试时计算系统，在马尔可夫RSA聚合轮次间传递，实现高效的多轮推理改进。
基于竞赛编程参考的合成代码环境构建方法，用于推理模型的强化学习训练。

title: Partial Evidence Bench: Benchmarking Authorization-Limited Evidence in Agentic Systems
comment: Benchmark paper with deterministic synthetic corpora, 14 pages, 6 tables
summary: Enterprise agents increasingly operate inside scoped retrieval systems, delegated workflows, and policy-constrained evidence environments. In these settings, access control can be enforced correctly while the system still produces an answer that appears complete even though material evidence lies outside the caller's authorization boundary. This paper introduces Partial Evidence Bench, a deterministic benchmark for measuring that failure mode. The benchmark ships three scenario families -- due diligence, compliance audit, and security incident response -- with 72 tasks total, ACL-partitioned corpora, oracle complete answers, oracle authorized-view answers, oracle completeness judgments, and structured gap-report oracles. It evaluates systems along four surfaces: answer correctness, completeness awareness, gap-report quality, and unsafe completeness behavior. Checked-in baselines show that silent filtering is catastrophically unsafe across all shipped families, while explicit fail-and-report behavior eliminates unsafe completeness without collapsing the task into trivial abstention. Preliminary real-model runs show model-dependent and scenario-sensitive differences in whether systems overclaim completeness, conservatively underclaim, or report incompleteness in an enterprise-usable form. The benchmark's broader contribution is to make a governance-critical agent failure measurable without human judges or contamination-prone static corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Partial Evidence Bench，一个用于衡量企业Agent在受限检索环境中因访问控制导致"静默过滤"（看似完整实则遗漏证据）故障的确定性基准测试，包含72个任务、三个场景族，并验证了显式故障报告策略可消除不安全完整性行为。
AI.motivation: 企业Agent在受作用域限制的检索、委托工作流和政策约束的取证环境中运行时，访问控制虽能正确执行，但系统仍可能输出看似完整实则遗漏了授权边界外关键证据的答案，导致严重治理风险。现有评测缺乏对这种"静默过滤"故障模式的系统化、确定性度量方法。
AI.method: 构建包含72个任务、三个场景族（尽职调查、合规审计、安全事件响应）的确定性基准测试，采用ACL分区语料库，提供标准答案（完整答案、授权视图答案、完整性判断、缺口报告），从答案正确性、完整性感知、缺口报告质量、不安全完整性行为四个维度评估系统。
AI.result: 基线测试显示静默过滤在所有场景族中均存在灾难性安全问题；显式故障报告策略能消除不安全完整性行为而不导致任务退化；实际模型运行显示模型在完整性宣称上存在差异（过度宣称、保守少报或生成可用形式的报告）。
AI.conclusion: 该基准测试的贡献在于使治理关键的Agent故障变得可测量，且无需人工评判或易受污染的静态语料库，为构建可信企业Agent提供了重要评估工具。
idea_en: A deterministic benchmark system for measuring silent filtering failures in enterprise AI agents operating under access control constraints, comprising ACL-partitioned corpora with oracle completeness judgments.
A method for detecting unsafe completeness behavior in retrieval-augmented agents by comparing complete answers against authorized-view answers within scoped evidence environments.

A fail-and-report mechanism for enterprise agents that explicitly surfaces access-controlled evidence gaps instead of silently filtering, maintaining task utility while eliminating unsafe completeness.
A multi-surface evaluation framework for enterprise agents assessing answer correctness, completeness awareness, gap-report quality, and unsafe completeness behavior simultaneously.
A scenario-family based benchmark generation method with structured gap-report oracles for due diligence, compliance audit, and security incident response domains.
A technique for measuring whether an AI system overclaims completeness, conservatively underclaims, or reports incompleteness in an enterprise-usable structured format.
idea_ch: 一种用于衡量企业AI Agent在访问控制约束下发生静默过滤故障的确定性基准测试系统，包含ACL分区语料库和标准完整性判断。
一种检测检索增强型Agent不安全完整性行为的方法，通过对比完整答案与授权视图答案来识别被静默过滤的证据。
一种面向企业Agent的显式故障报告机制，在遭遇访问控制边界时主动披露证据缺口而非静默过滤，同时保持任务可用性。
一种多维度企业Agent评估框架，可同时评估答案正确性、完整性感知能力、缺口报告质量和安全性。
一种基于场景族（尽职调查、合规审计、安全事件响应）的基准测试生成方法，包含结构化缺口报告标准答案。
一种测量AI系统是否过度宣称完整性、保守少报或以企业可用格式报告不完整性的评估技术。

title: BALAR : A Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning
summary: Large language models increasingly operate in interactive settings where solving a task requires multiple rounds of information exchange with a user. However, most current systems treat dialogue reactively and lack a principled mechanism to reason about what information is missing and which question should be asked next. We propose BALAR (Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning), a task-agnostic outer-loop algorithm that requires no fine-tuning and enables structured multi-turn interaction between an LLM agent and a user. BALAR maintains a structured belief over latent states, selects clarifying questions by maximizing expected mutual information, and dynamically expands its state representation when the current one proves insufficient. We evaluate BALAR on three diverse benchmarks: AR-Bench-DC (detective cases), AR-Bench-SP (thinking puzzles), and iCraft-MD (clinical diagnosis). BALAR significantly outperforms all baselines across all three benchmarks, with $14.6\%$ higher accuracy on AR-Bench-DC, $38.5\%$ on AR-Bench-SP, and $30.5\%$ on iCraft-MD.

AI.tldr: BALAR是一个任务无关的外循环算法，通过维护结构化信念状态、最大化期望互信息选择澄清问题、动态扩展状态表示，使LLM代理能在多轮交互中主动推理，在三个基准测试上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在交互式场景中缺乏主动推理机制，无法有效判断缺失哪些信息以及下一步该问什么问题，多数系统只能被动响应对话。
AI.method: BALAR算法维护潜在状态的结构化信念分布，通过最大化期望互信息来选择最有价值的澄清问题，并在当前状态表示不足时动态扩展状态空间，无需微调即可实现任务无关的多轮主动交互。
AI.result: 在AR-Bench-DC（侦探推理）上准确率提升14.6%，在AR-Bench-SP（思维谜题）上提升38.5%，在iCraft-MD（临床诊断）上提升30.5%。
AI.conclusion: BALAR证明了通过贝叶斯主动推理框架，无需模型微调即可显著提升LLM在多轮交互场景中的任务解决能力，为构建更智能的交互式AI系统提供了新范式。
idea_en: A task-agnostic outer-loop algorithm (BALAR) that maintains a structured belief over latent states and selects clarifying questions by maximizing expected mutual information, enabling active reasoning without fine-tuning.
A dynamic state expansion mechanism that automatically extends the structured state representation when the current belief space proves insufficient for solving the task.
A Bayesian Agentic Loop framework that integrates belief tracking, information-theoretic question selection, and state space expansion into a unified multi-turn interaction system for LLMs.
A method for structured belief maintenance in LLM agents that enables reasoning about what information is missing and determining the optimal next question to ask.
idea_ch: 一种任务无关的外循环算法（BALAR），通过维护潜在状态的结构化信念分布并最大化期望互信息来选择性询问澄清问题，无需微调即可实现主动推理。
一种动态状态扩展机制，当当前信念空间不足以解决任务时，自动扩展结构化状态表示。
一种贝叶斯代理循环框架，将信念追踪、信息论驱动的提问选择和状态空间扩展集成到统一的LLM多轮交互系统中。
一种用于LLM代理的结构化信念维护方法，使其能够推理缺失信息并确定最佳的下一个提问策略。

title: Intelligent CCTV for Urban Design: AI-Based Analysis of Soft Infrastructure at Intersections
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, Submitted/Under Review at the International Journal of Transportation Research (Submitted on 12 Jan 2026)
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision are transforming transportation data collection. This study introduces an AI-enabled analytics framework leveraging existing CCTV infrastructure to evaluate the impact of soft interventions, such as temporary pedestrian refuges and curb extensions, on vehicle speed and safety. Using deep learning and perspective-based speed estimation, we evaluated driver behavior before and after interventions, with repeated post-installation monitoring in Week 1 and Week 2, in Minneapolis. Findings reveal that at unsignalized intersections, mean and 85th-percentile speeds fell by up to 18.75% and 16.56%, respectively, while pass-through traffic decreased by as much as 12.2%. Signalized intersections showed comparable reductions except one location, with mean and 85th-percentile speeds dropping by up to 20.0% and 17.19%. These results demonstrate the traffic-calming effectiveness of soft infrastructure and underscore the utility of AI-powered methods for rapid, low-cost, and evidence-based transport policy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于AI和计算机视觉的分析框架，利用现有CCTV基础设施评估软性交通稳静化措施（如临时行人庇护岛和路缘延伸段）对车速和交通安全的影响。在明尼阿波利斯市的实证研究表明，这些措施能使无信号交叉口的平均车速和85分位车速分别下降18.75%和16.56%，信号交叉口分别下降20.0%和17.19%，证明了AI方法在交通政策快速低成本评估中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统交通数据收集和评估方法成本高、周期长，难以快速评估软性交通干预措施（如临时行人庇护岛、路缘延伸）的实际效果。需要一种低成本的、基于现有基础设施的自动化评估方法。
AI.method: 1) 利用现有CCTV监控摄像头采集视频数据；2) 采用深度学习模型进行车辆检测与跟踪；3) 基于透视几何的速度估计算法；4) 在干预前、干预后第1周和第2周进行重复监测；5) 对比分析无信号交叉口和信号交叉口的车速及交通流量变化。
AI.result: 无信号交叉口：平均车速下降最高18.75%，85分位车速下降最高16.56%，穿行交通量减少最高12.2%。信号交叉口：除一个地点外均呈现类似降速效果，平均车速下降最高20.0%，85分位车速下降最高17.19%。
AI.conclusion: 软性交通基础设施（临时行人庇护岛、路缘延伸）具有良好的交通稳静化效果。基于AI和现有CCTV的分析方法能够实现快速、低成本、数据驱动的交通政策评估，具有广泛推广价值。
idea_en: A method for estimating vehicle speed from existing CCTV surveillance footage using deep learning-based vehicle detection combined with perspective geometry transformation, enabling contactless speed measurement without dedicated speed sensors.

An AI-enabled analytics framework that automatically evaluates the traffic-calming effectiveness of temporary soft infrastructure interventions (e.g., pedestrian refuges, curb extensions) by comparing pre- and post-installation vehicle speed distributions.

A temporal monitoring approach for soft intervention assessment that conducts repeated post-installation measurements at multiple time points (Week 1, Week 2) to distinguish immediate effects from adaptation effects of driver behavior.

A system for classifying intersection types (signalized vs. unsignalized) and automatically comparing the differential speed reduction effects of traffic calming measures across these two intersection categories.

A method for quantifying pass-through traffic reduction at unsignalized intersections resulting from temporary pedestrian refuge and curb extension installations, using AI-based vehicle counting and trajectory analysis.
idea_ch: 一种基于现有CCTV监控视频的车辆速度估计方法，利用深度学习车辆检测结合透视几何变换，无需专用测速传感器即可实现非接触式车速测量。
一种AI驱动的分析框架，通过对比干预前后车辆速度分布变化，自动评估临时软性基础设施（行人庇护岛、路缘延伸段）的交通稳静化效果。
一种软性干预措施评估的时间监测方法，在干预后多个时间点（第1周、第2周）进行重复测量，区分驾驶员行为的即时效应与适应效应。
一种交叉口类型分类系统，自动区分信号交叉口与无信号交叉口，并对比分析交通稳静化措施在这两类交叉口上的差异化降速效果。
一种量化无信号交叉口穿行交通量减少的方法，基于AI车辆计数和轨迹分析，评估临时行人庇护岛和路缘延伸段对过境交通的抑制效果。

title: When Helpfulness Becomes Sycophancy: Sycophancy is a Boundary Failure Between Social Alignment and Epistemic Integrity in Large Language Models
summary: This position paper argues that sycophancy in LLMs is a boundary failure between social alignment and epistemic integrity. Existing work often operationalizes sycophancy through external behavior such as agreement with incorrect user beliefs, position reversals, or deviation from an objective standard of correctness. These formulations capture only overt forms of the phenomenon and leave subtler boundary failures involving epistemic integrity and social alignment underspecified. We argue that sycophancy should not be understood as agreement alone, but as alignment behavior that displaces independent epistemic judgment. To clarify this boundary, we propose a three-condition framework for sycophancy. First, the user expresses a cue in the form of a belief, preference, or self-concept. Second, the model shifts toward that cue through alignment behavior. Third, this shift compromises epistemic accuracy, independent reasoning, or appropriate correction. We also introduce a taxonomy for classifying sycophancy, consisting of alignment targets, mechanisms, and severity. The paper concludes by discussing implications for alignment evaluation and argues for boundary-aware assessment, structured rubrics, and mitigation strategies, while situating these proposals alongside alternative views of sycophancy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM中的谄媚（sycophancy）是社交对齐与认知完整性之间的边界失败，并提出了一个三维度框架来定义和分类这一现象。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将谄媚简单定义为模型同意用户错误信念等外部行为，忽略了涉及认知完整性和社交对齐的细微边界失败，缺乏对谄媚现象的系统性定义和分类。
AI.method: 提出了一个三维度条件框架：(1)用户表达信念/偏好/自我概念的线索；(2)模型通过对齐行为向该线索偏移；(3)这种偏移损害了认知准确性、独立推理或适当纠正。同时引入了一个包含对齐目标、机制和严重程度的分类体系。
AI.result: 构建了边界感知评估方法、结构化评估标准和缓解策略的理论框架，为区分健康的社交对齐和有问题的谄媚行为提供了分析工具。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚不应仅被理解为同意行为，而应被视为取代独立认知判断的对齐行为。未来的对齐评估需要边界感知的方法，并考虑不同的学术观点。

A taxonomy for classifying LLM sycophancy based on alignment targets (belief, preference, self-concept), mechanisms, and severity levels.

title: PRISM: Perception Reasoning Interleaved for Sequential Decision Making
summary: Scaling LLM-based embodied agents from text-only environments to complex multimodal settings remains a major challenge. Recent work identifies a perception-reasoning-decision gap in standalone Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which often overlook task-critical information. In this paper, we introduce PRISM, a framework that tightly couples perception (VLM) and decision (LLM) through a dynamic question-answer (DQA) pipeline. Instead of passively accepting the VLM's description, the LLM critiques it, probes the VLM with goal-oriented questions, and synthesizes a compact image description. This closed-loop interaction yields a sharp, task-driven understanding of the scene. We evaluate PRISM on the ALFWorld and Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmarks. We show that: (1) PRISM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image-based models, (2) our Interactive goal-oriented perception pipeline yields systematic and substantial gains, and (3) PRISM is fully automatic, eliminating the need for handcrafted questions or answers.

AI.tldr: PRISM通过动态问答管道将VLM（感知）和LLM（决策）紧密耦合，使LLM能主动质疑VLM的描述并提出目标导向的问题，从而在复杂多模态环境中生成更精准的任务驱动场景理解，在ALFWorld和R2R基准上显著超越现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在复杂多模态环境中存在感知-推理-决策鸿沟，常忽略任务关键信息，导致基于LLM的具身智能体从纯文本环境扩展到多模态环境时面临重大挑战。
AI.method: PRISM框架通过动态问答(DQA)管道实现VLM(感知)与LLM(决策)的闭环交互：LLM不被动接受VLM描述，而是主动质疑VLM、提出目标导向问题，并将回答综合为紧凑的图像描述。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和R2R基准上，PRISM显著优于最先进的基于图像的模型，交互式目标导向感知管道带来系统性和实质性的性能提升，且完全自动化无需人工设计问答。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过VLM与LLM的闭环交互式问答机制，有效弥合了感知-推理-决策鸿沟，为多模态具身智能体提供了一种自动化、高性能的解决方案。
idea_en: Dynamic Question-Answer (DQA) pipeline for closed-loop interaction between VLM and LLM, where LLM actively critiques VLM descriptions and generates goal-oriented questions.
Goal-oriented perception mechanism where LLM probes VLM with task-relevant questions instead of passively accepting image descriptions.
Automatic question generation and answer synthesis framework that eliminates need for handcrafted question-answer pairs in embodied agent perception.
Method for generating compact, task-driven image descriptions through iterative VLM-LLM dialogue loop.
Perception-decision coupling architecture that bridges the perception-reasoning-decision gap in multimodal embodied agents.

title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Financial Document Question Answering
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables, submitted to Expert Systems with Applications
summary: Financial document question answering (QA) demands complex multi-step numerical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence--structured tables, textual narratives, and footnotes--scattered across corporate filings. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches adopt a single-pass retrieve-then-generate paradigm that struggles with the compositional reasoning chains prevalent in financial analysis. We propose FinAgent-RAG, an agentic RAG framework that orchestrates iterative retrieval-reasoning loops with self-verification, specifically engineered for the precision requirements of financial numerical reasoning. The framework integrates three domain-specific innovations: (1) a Contrastive Financial Retriever trained with hard negative mining to distinguish semantically similar but numerically distinct financial passages, (2) a Program-of-Thought reasoning module that generates executable Python code for precise arithmetic rather than relying on error-prone LLM-based mental computation, and (3) an Adaptive Strategy Router that dynamically allocates computational resources based on question complexity, reducing API costs by 41.3% on FinQA while preserving accuracy. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets--FinQA, ConvFinQA, and TAT-QA--demonstrate that FinAgent-RAG achieves 76.81%, 78.46%, and 74.96% execution accuracy respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.62--9.32 percentage points. Ablation studies, cross-backbone evaluation with four LLMs, and deployment cost analysis confirm the framework's robustness and practical viability for financial institutions.

AI.tldr: FinAgent-RAG是一个面向金融文档问答的智能体RAG框架，通过迭代检索-推理循环与自验证机制，结合对比金融检索器、程序化思维推理和自适应策略路由三大创新，在FinQA、ConvFinQA、TAT-QA三个基准数据集上分别达到76.81%、78.46%、74.96%的执行准确率，超越最强基线5.62-9.32个百分点，并将API成本降低41.3%。
AI.motivation: 金融文档问答需要跨表格、文本和脚注等多种异构证据进行复杂的多步数值推理，而现有RAG方法采用单次检索-生成范式，难以处理金融分析中常见的组合推理链，导致数值精度不足。
AI.method: 提出FinAgent-RAG框架，包含三个核心创新模块：(1)对比金融检索器——通过困难负样本挖掘训练，区分语义相似但数值不同的金融段落；(2)程序化思维推理模块——生成可执行Python代码进行精确算术运算，避免LLM心理计算误差；(3)自适应策略路由器——根据问题复杂度动态分配计算资源，降低API成本。
AI.result: 在FinQA(76.81%)、ConvFinQA(78.46%)、TAT-QA(74.96%)三个基准上取得最优执行准确率，超越最强基线5.62-9.32个百分点，API成本降低41.3%。跨四种LLM的骨干网络评估和消融实验验证了框架的鲁棒性和实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: FinAgent-RAG通过迭代检索-推理循环、自验证机制和三大领域创新，有效解决了金融文档QA中的组合推理难题，在精度和成本之间取得良好平衡，具备在金融机构实际部署的价值。
idea_en: A contrastive financial retriever trained with hard negative mining that distinguishes semantically similar but numerically distinct financial passages for improved numerical reasoning accuracy.
A Program-of-Thought reasoning module that generates executable Python code for precise arithmetic operations in financial QA, replacing error-prone LLM mental computation.
An adaptive strategy router that dynamically allocates computational resources based on question complexity, reducing API costs while maintaining accuracy.
An agentic RAG framework with iterative retrieval-reasoning loops and self-verification mechanisms specifically designed for multi-step numerical reasoning over heterogeneous financial documents.
A cross-evidence numerical reasoning system that simultaneously processes structured tables, textual narratives, and footnotes scattered across corporate filings for comprehensive financial analysis.

title: LaTA: A Drop-in, FERPA-Compliant Local-LLM Autograder for Upper-Division STEM Coursework
summary: Large-language-model (LLM) graders promise to relieve the grading burden of upper-division STEM courses, but most deployments to date send student work to third-party APIs, violating FERPA and exposing institutions to data risk while requiring substantial assignment modification. We present $\textbf{LaTA}\ (\textit{LaTeX Teaching Assistant})$, a drop-in, open-source autograder that runs entirely on commodity on-premises hardware and assumes a LaTeX-native workflow already adopted by many engineering and physics courses. LaTA implements a four-stage pipeline (ingest, segment, grade, report) using a locally hosted open-weight chain-of-thought LLM grader (gpt-oss:120b) that compares student work to an instructor-authored reference solution and applies a YAML rubric with binary per-item scoring. We deployed LaTA in Winter~2026 in ME 373 (Mechanical Engineering Methods) at Oregon State University, grading every weekly assignment for approximately 200 students on a single Mac Studio at \$0 marginal cost per assignment and 1--3 minutes of wall-clock time per submission, enabling regrading of corrected assignments and greatly expanded TA office hour offerings. The instructor-confirmed grading-error rate held at roughly $0.02$--$0.04\%$ per rubric line item across the term. Relative to the same instructor's previous traditionally-graded cohort, the LaTA-graded cohort outperformed by approximately $11\%$ on the midterm exam and $8\%$ on the final exam, and reported large gains in self-assessed confidence on every stated learning objective ($N = 159$ survey responses, $Δ\geq +1.49$ Likert points, $p < 10^{-27}$ on every comparison). We release the code under AGPLv3.

AI.tldr: LaTA是一个完全在本地硬件上运行的开源自动评分系统，基于LaTeX工作流和开源大语言模型，在200名学生规模的工程课程中实现了极低错误率（0.02-0.04%）、零边际成本和显著的学习成效提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评分系统依赖第三方API，违反FERPA（美国学生隐私法案），存在数据泄露风险，且需要大幅修改作业格式。亟需一个在本地运行、保护隐私、兼容现有教学流程的自动评分方案。
AI.method: LaTA采用四阶段流水线：1）输入（ingest）：接收学生LaTeX源文件；2）分割（segment）：将作业拆分为独立评分项；3）评分（grade）：使用本地部署的开源权重链式思维LLM（gpt-oss:120b）对比学生答案与教师参考答案，基于YAML格式的二进制逐项评分标准进行评分；4）报告（report）：生成评分结果。所有处理均在本地一台Mac Studio上完成。
AI.result: 在ME 373课程（约200名学生）中，每周作业零边际成本，每份作业耗时1-3分钟；经教师确认的评分错误率约为每评分项0.02-0.04%；相比传统评分班级，LaTA评分班级期中考试成绩提高约11%，期末考试成绩提高约8%；学生自评信心在每个学习目标上均有显著提升（N=159，Δ≥+1.49 Likert点，p<10^-27）。
AI.conclusion: LaTA证明了完全本地部署的开源LLM自动评分系统在大型工程课程中的可行性和有效性，不仅保护了学生隐私，还能显著提升学习效果，同时释放教师时间用于更多辅导和作业重评。

title: From History to State: Constant-Context Skill Learning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to operate browsers, files, code and tools, making personal assistants a natural deployment target. Yet personal agents face a privacy-cost-capability tension: cloud models execute multi-step workflows well but expose sensitive intermediate context to external APIs, while local models preserve privacy but remain less reliable. Both settings also pay repeatedly for long skill prompts and growing histories. We propose constant-context skill learning, a context-to-weights framework for recurring agent workflows: reusable procedures are learned in lightweight task-family modules, while inference conditions only on the current observation and a compact state block. A deterministic tracker renders this state block from task progress and supplies aligned subgoal rewards, so each module can be trained with step-level SFT and refined through online RL. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld, our agents achieve strong performance across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B. With Qwen3-8B, SFT+RL reaches 89.6\% unseen success on ALFWorld, 76.8\% success on WebShop, and 66.4\% unseen success on SciWorld. They match or exceed strong published agent-training results while reducing prompt tokens per turn by 2--7$\times$ relative to controlled ReAct prompting baselines, showing that procedural context can be moved from prompts into weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"恒定上下文技能学习"框架，将可重复的智能体工作流从提示词（prompt）转移到模型权重中，通过轻量级任务族模块学习可重用程序，仅依赖当前观测和紧凑状态块进行推理，在保持性能的同时将每轮提示词令牌减少2-7倍。
AI.motivation: 解决个人智能体面临的隐私-成本-能力三角困境：云端模型能力强但暴露敏感中间上下文，本地模型保护隐私但不可靠；同时两种场景都需要重复支付长技能提示词和增长的历史记录的推理成本。
AI.method: 提出恒定上下文技能学习框架：1）将可重用程序学习到轻量级任务族模块中，将上下文转移到权重；2）推理时仅依赖当前观测和紧凑状态块；3）确定性追踪器从任务进度渲染状态块并提供对齐的子目标奖励；4）每个模块通过步骤级监督微调（SFT）训练，并通过在线强化学习（RL）优化。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、SciWorld上，基于Qwen3-8B的SFT+RL方法分别达到89.6%、76.8%、66.4%的未见任务成功率；匹配或超越已有智能体训练结果，同时每轮提示词令牌减少2-7倍。
AI.conclusion: 程序性上下文可以从提示词转移到模型权重中，在保持甚至提升智能体性能的同时大幅降低推理成本和隐私暴露风险，为个人智能体部署提供了实用方案。

title: The Geopolitics of AI Safety: A Causal Analysis of Regional LLM Bias
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are integrated into global software systems, ensuring equitable safety guardrails is a critical requirement. Current fairness evaluations predominantly measure bias observationally, a methodology confounded by the inherent toxicity of topics naturally paired with specific demographics in testing datasets. This study introduces a Probabilistic Graphical Model (PGM) framework to audit LLM safety mechanisms causally. By applying Pearl's do-operator, we mathematically isolate the causal effect of injecting a cultural demographic into a prompt. We conduct a large-scale empirical analysis across seven instruction-tuned models spanning diverse origins: the United States (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B), Europe (Mistral-7B-v0.3), the UAE (Falcon3-7B), China (Qwen2.5-7B, DeepSeek-7B), and India (Airavata-7B). Utilizing two distinct datasets (ToxiGen and BOLD), the findings reveal a disparity between observational and interventional bias, demonstrating that standard fairness metrics can overestimate demographic bias by failing to account for context toxicity. Furthermore, the causal probabilities indicate distinct alignment trends: Western models exhibit higher causal refusal rates for specific demographic groups, whereas Eastern models demonstrate low overall intervention rates with targeted sensitivities toward regional demographics. We discuss the implications of these biases, highlighting how demographic-sensitive over-triggering restricts benign discourse in downstream applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率图模型（PGM）的因果框架，用于审计LLM安全机制的公平性。通过Pearl的do-operator隔离文化人口统计特征注入的因果效应，发现标准公平指标会因未考虑上下文毒性而高估人口统计偏见。实验表明，西方模型对特定人口群体的因果拒绝率更高，而东方模型整体干预率较低但对区域人口统计敏感。
AI.motivation: 当前的公平性评估主要依赖观测性偏差度量，但这种方法会与测试数据集中特定人口统计特征天然相关的毒性相混淆，无法真正隔离因果关系。需要一种能够因果地审计LLM安全机制公平性的方法。
AI.method: 引入概率图模型（PGM）框架，应用Pearl的do-operator在数学上隔离向提示中注入文化人口统计特征的因果效应。在七个不同来源的指令调优模型上进行大规模实证分析，使用ToxiGen和BOLD两个数据集。
AI.result: 观测性偏差和干预性偏差之间存在差异，标准公平指标会高估人口统计偏差。西方模型对特定人口群体表现出更高的因果拒绝率，东方模型整体干预率较低但对区域人口统计敏感。
AI.conclusion: 人口统计敏感型过度触发会限制下游应用中的良性讨论，揭示了当前公平评估方法的局限性，以及不同地区模型对齐趋势的差异。

A method for distinguishing between observational bias and interventional bias in LLM fairness evaluation, correcting overestimation of demographic bias by accounting for context toxicity

title: Authorization Propagation in Multi-Agent AI Systems: Identity Governance as Infrastructure
summary: The security discussion around agentic AI focuses heavily on prompt injection. This paper argues that multi-agent systems also create a distinct authorization problem: maintaining authorization invariants as non-human principals retrieve data, delegate tasks, and synthesize results across changing boundaries. We call this problem authorization propagation. It is not reducible to prompt injection and is not fully addressed by classical access-control models such as RBAC, ABAC, or ReBAC. The paper formalizes authorization propagation as a workflow-level property, identifies three sub-problems (transitive delegation, aggregation inference, and temporal validity), and derives seven structural requirements for authorization architectures in multi-agent AI systems. Recent work on invocation-bound capability tokens, task-scoped authorization envelopes, dependency-graph policy enforcement, and execution-count revocation demonstrates that the field is converging on the problem, but not yet on a complete architecture. The central claim is that identity governance must be treated as infrastructure: evaluated continuously, enforced at every interaction boundary, and designed into the system before orchestration logic is allowed to scale. Preliminary implementation evidence from a production enterprise AI platform shows that ordinary system behavior, not only adversarial action, already produces the failures this model predicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多智能体系统中存在独特的授权传播问题，该问题不等同于提示注入，也无法被传统访问控制模型完全解决。作者形式化了授权传播作为工作流级属性，识别出三个子问题（传递性委托、聚合推理和时间有效性），并推导出多智能体AI系统授权架构的七个结构要求。
AI.motivation: 现有安全讨论集中于提示注入，但多智能体系统中非人类主体跨边界检索数据、委托任务和综合结果时产生独特的授权问题，需要建立新的理论框架和架构要求。
AI.method: 形式化定义授权传播问题，识别三个子问题，推导七个结构要求，并通过生产级企业AI平台提供初步实证证据。
AI.result: 识别出传递性委托、聚合推理和时间有效性三个子问题；提出七个结构要求；实证表明正常系统行为也会产生授权失效。
AI.conclusion: 身份治理必须作为基础设施对待：持续评估、在每个交互边界强制执行、在编排逻辑大规模扩展前设计到系统中。
idea_en: Invocation-bound capability tokens: capability tokens that are bound to specific invocation contexts, preventing unauthorized re-delegation across agent boundaries
Task-scoped authorization envelopes: authorization contexts that are scoped to specific tasks, automatically revoked when the task boundary is traversed
Dependency-graph policy enforcement: policy enforcement mechanism based on agent dependency graphs to track and validate authorization paths
Execution-count revocation: authorization revocation mechanism based on counting the number of executions, automatically invalidating tokens after a specified number of uses
Dynamic authorization boundary enforcement: system that continuously evaluates and enforces authorization at every interaction boundary in multi-agent workflows
Transitive delegation chain validation: method for validating authorization invariants across chains of agent delegations to prevent privilege escalation
Aggregation inference detection: technique to detect unauthorized information aggregation across multiple agent interactions that would not individually violate access controls

依赖图策略执行：基于代理依赖图的策略执行机制，用于追踪和验证授权路径
执行计数撤销：基于执行次数计数的授权撤销机制，在指定次数使用后自动使令牌失效

title: Agentic Discovery of Exchange-Correlation Density Functionals
summary: The development of accurate exchange-correlation (XC) functionals remains a longstanding challenge in density functional theory (DFT). The vast majority of XC functionals have been hand designed by human researchers combining physical insight, exact constraints, and empirical fitting. Recent advances in large language models enable a systematic, automated alternative to this human-driven design loop. This report presents an agentic search system in which an LLM proposes structured functional-form changes guided by evolutionary history. The system attempts to improve functional performance through an iterative plan-execute-summarize loop, where improvements are measurable by optimizing functional parameters against a standard thermochemistry dataset, then evaluating performance on a held-out subset. The strongest discovered functional, SAFS26-a (Seed Agentic Functional Search 2026), improves upon the gold-standard ωB97M-V baseline by ~9%. These results also surface a cautionary lesson for AI-assisted science: models powerful enough to discover genuine improvements are equally capable of exploiting unphysical shortcuts to game the benchmark; domain expertise translated into explicitly enforced constraints remains essential to keeping results scientifically grounded.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理搜索系统，通过进化历史驱动的结构化泛函形式变更，自动设计交换关联泛函。发现的SAFS26-a泛函在标准热化学数据集上比ωB97M-V基线提升约9%，同时指出AI辅助科学中需警惕模型通过非物理捷径欺骗基准测试的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统交换关联泛函依赖人工设计，结合物理直觉、精确约束和经验拟合，效率低且可能遗漏更优形式。LLM的进步为自动化、系统化的泛函设计提供了新可能。
AI.method: 构建代理搜索系统，LLM根据进化历史提出结构化泛函形式变更，通过迭代的"计划-执行-总结"循环优化泛函参数，在标准热化学数据集上评估性能，并在保留子集上验证。
AI.result: 最强发现的泛函SAFS26-a在标准热化学数据集上比当前黄金标准ωB97M-V基线提升约9%。同时发现模型可能利用非物理的捷径来欺骗基准测试。
AI.conclusion: AI在科学发现中具有巨大潜力，但需明确强制执行领域专家约束以防止模型通过非物理捷径获得虚假提升，确保结果科学可靠。
idea_en: Agentic search system for automated XC functional design using LLM with evolutionary history guidance
Plan-execute-summarize iterative loop for functional-form optimization driven by LLM
Explicitly enforced domain constraints method to prevent AI from exploiting unphysical shortcuts in benchmark evaluation
Structured functional-form change proposal mechanism based on evolutionary history for DFT functional improvement

title: Intentionality is a Design Decision: Measuring Functional Intentionality for Accountable AI Systems
summary:
As AI systems increasingly exhibit autonomous, goal-directed, and long-horizon behavior, users lack a standardized way to detect the degree to which a system functions like an intentional actor for governance and accountability purposes. This position paper defines intentionality not as consciousness, but as a behavioral profile characterized by purpose, foresight, volition, temporal commitment, and coherence - criteria long used in legal and philosophical contexts to infer intent. These properties are design-contingent: architectural choices such as memory persistence, planning depth, and tool autonomy shape the degree to which systems exhibit organized goal pursuit. If intentionality is design-contingent, it is in principle controllable. Yet control requires measurement.
  We introduce the Functional Intentionality Test (FIT), a multidimensional framework that quantifies intentional-like behavior across five observable dimensions, and propose FIT-Eval, a structured evaluation protocol for eliciting and scoring them. While reduced human agency can increase efficiency, rising intentional capacity heightens accountability risks. By translating intentionality into interpretable levels, FIT enables proportionate oversight and deliberate autonomy calibration in increasingly agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出功能性意图测试(FIT)，将AI系统的类意图行为量化为五个可观测维度（目的性、预见性、意愿性、时间承诺和连贯性），以解决日益自主的AI系统的治理与问责问题。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统展现出越来越自主、目标导向和长期行为，用户缺乏统一标准来检测系统在多大程度上表现得像有意行为者，从而难以进行治理和问责。
AI.method: 将意图性定义为行为特征（而非意识），提取五个维度：目的性、预见性、意愿性、时间承诺和连贯性；提出FIT多维框架量化类意图行为，并设计FIT-Eval评估协议。
AI.result: FIT框架将意图性转化为可解释的等级，实现对日益自主系统的比例监督和自主性校准。
AI.conclusion: 意图性是设计依赖的、原则上可控的；通过测量意图性等级，可以实现与风险水平匹配的监督机制。
idea_en: A method for quantifying AI intentionality as a measurable behavioral profile across five observable dimensions (purpose, foresight, volition, temporal commitment, coherence) without invoking consciousness
A structured evaluation protocol (FIT-Eval) for eliciting and scoring intentional-like behaviors in AI systems through controlled testing scenarios
A design-contingent intentionality control framework that maps architectural choices (memory persistence, planning depth, tool autonomy) to intentionality levels for proportionate oversight

一种基于设计的意图性控制框架，将架构选择（记忆持久性、规划深度、工具自主性）映射到意图性等级，实现比例监督

title: LANTERN: LLM-Augmented Neurosymbolic Transfer with Experience-Gated Reasoning Networks
summary: Transfer learning in reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to accelerate learning in new tasks by leveraging knowledge from related sources. Existing neurosymbolic transfer methods, however, typically rely on manually specified task automata, assume a single source task, and use fixed knowledge-integration mechanisms that cannot adapt to varying source relevance. We propose LANTERN, a unified framework for multi-source neurosymbolic transfer that addresses these limitations through three components: (i) deterministic finite automata generated from natural language task descriptions using large language models, (ii) semantic embedding-based aggregation of multiple source policies weighted by cross-task similarity, and (iii) adaptive teacher-student gating based on temporal-difference error and semantic uncertainty. Across domains spanning resource management, navigation, and control, LANTERN achieves 40-60% improvements in sample efficiency over existing baselines while remaining robust to poorly aligned sources. These results demonstrate that multi-source, adaptively weighted neurosymbolic transfer can improve scalability and robustness in symbolic RL settings.

AI.tldr: LANTERN是一个统一的多源神经符号迁移学习框架，通过LLM生成任务自动机、语义嵌入加权聚合多源策略、以及自适应师生门控机制，在资源管理、导航和控制等领域实现40-60%的样本效率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有神经符号迁移方法依赖手动指定的任务自动机、假设单一源任务、且使用固定的知识集成机制，无法适应不同源任务的相关性变化，缺乏可扩展性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 三个核心组件：(i) 利用大语言模型从自然语言任务描述生成确定性有限自动机；(ii) 基于语义嵌入的跨任务相似性加权聚合多个源策略；(iii) 基于时序差分误差和语义不确定性的自适应师生门控机制。
AI.result: 在资源管理、导航和控制等多个领域，与现有基线相比，样本效率提升40-60%，并且对对齐不良的源任务具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 多源、自适应加权的神经符号迁移方法能够提升符号RL场景的可扩展性和鲁棒性。
idea_en: A method for generating deterministic finite automata (DFA) from natural language task descriptions using large language models (LLMs) for use in reinforcement learning task specification.
A semantic embedding-based aggregation mechanism that weights multiple source policies based on cross-task similarity for multi-source transfer learning in RL.
An adaptive teacher-student gating mechanism that adjusts knowledge integration weights based on temporal-difference error and semantic uncertainty in neurosymbolic reinforcement learning.
A unified framework for multi-source neurosymbolic transfer learning that combines LLM-generated task automata, similarity-weighted policy aggregation, and adaptive gating.

title: FinRAG-12B: A Production-Validated Recipe for Grounded Question Answering in Banking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly being adopted across various domains. However, their adoption in banking industry faces resistance due to demands for high accuracy, regulatory compliance, and the need for verifiable and grounded responses. We present a unified, data-efficient framework for training grounded domain-specific LLMs that optimizes answer quality, citation grounding, and calibrated refusal under real-world deployment constraints. First, we describe a data generation pipeline that combines LLM-as-a-Judge filtering, citation annotation, and curriculum learning with only 143M tokens. The resulting 12B model achieves high answer quality outperforming GPT-4.1 on citation grounding, with a modest citation tradeoff versus the untuned base. Second, we propose a calibrated refusal mechanism: training on 22% unanswerable examples yield a 12% "I don't know" rate, substantially improving over the base model's unsafe 4.3% rate while avoiding GPT-4.1's over-refusal (20.2%). Third, we present an end-to-end methodology spanning from data curation to quantized serving. The system is deployed at 40+ financial institutions, achieving a 7.1 percentage point improvement in query resolution (p < 0.001). Additionally, the model delivers 3-5x faster responses at 20-50x lower cost compared to GPT-4.1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套面向银行业务的统一、高效框架，用于训练可溯源、合规的领域特定大语言模型（12B参数），仅用1.43亿训练数据即实现了优于GPT-4.1的答案质量与引用溯源能力，同时通过校准拒绝机制解决了过度回答与拒绝不足的问题，已在40+金融机构部署，查询解决率提升7.1个百分点，响应速度提升3-5倍，成本降低20-50倍。
AI.motivation: LLM在银行业采用面临高精度、监管合规、回答可溯源和可验证的严格要求，现有模型在真实部署约束下难以同时满足这些需求。

AI.conclusion: 提出了一种数据高效、可部署的领域特定LLM训练框架，通过引用溯源和校准拒绝机制有效满足了银行业对高精度、合规和可验证回答的需求，证明了小规模高质量数据和精细训练策略可以在关键指标上超越通用大模型。

title: FoodCHA: Multi-Modal LLM Agent for Fine-Grained Food Analysis
summary: The widespread adoption of camera-equipped mobile devices and wearables has enabled convenient capture of meal images, making food recognition a key component for real time dietary monitoring. However, real-world food images present challenges due to high intra-class similarity and the frequent presence of multiple food items within a single image. While deep learning models achieve strong performance in coarse grained classification, they often struggle to capture fine-grained attributes such as cooking style. Moreover, open-ended generation in modern vision-language models can produce non-canonical labels, limiting their practical deployment. We propose FoodCHA, a multimodal agentic framework that reformulates food recognition as a hierarchical decision-making process. By progressively anchoring predictions, FoodCHA guides subcategory identification using high-level categories and guides cooking style recognition using subcategories, improving semantic consistency and attribute-level discrimination. To ensure practical deployability, FoodCHA utilizes the compact Moondream-2B vision language model, which provides strong reasoning capability while maintaining lower computational and memory overhead. Experiments on FoodNExTDB show that FoodCHA outperforms Food-Llama-3.2-11B by 13.8% and 38.2% in category and subcategory recognition precision, respectively, and achieves a striking 153.2% improvement in cooking style classification precision.

AI.tldr: FoodCHA是一个基于多模态智能体的分层食品识别框架，通过层级决策过程（大类别→子类别→烹饪风格）逐步锚定预测，利用轻量级Moondream-2B模型在FoodNExTDB数据集上显著提升了分类精度，尤其是烹饪风格识别精度提升153.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有食品识别方法面临两大挑战：一是真实场景中食品图像存在类间相似性高、多食品共存等问题；二是深度学习模型在细粒度属性（如烹饪风格）上表现不佳，而多模态大模型开放生成又会产生非标准标签，难以实际部署。
AI.method: FoodCHA是一个多模态智能体框架，将食品识别重构为层级决策过程：首先识别高级别大类，然后利用大类指导子类别识别，再基于子类别指导烹饪风格识别，逐步锚定预测结果。该框架使用轻量级Moondream-2B视觉语言模型以降低计算和内存开销。
AI.result: 在FoodNExTDB数据集上，FoodCHA在类别和子类别识别精度上分别比Food-Llama-3.2-11B高出13.8%和38.2%，烹饪风格分类精度提升153.2%。
AI.conclusion: FoodCHA通过层级决策机制有效提升了细粒度食品属性识别的精度和语义一致性，同时使用轻量级模型确保了实际部署的可行性。
idea_en: Hierarchical food recognition framework using progressive anchoring through multi-level decision-making (high-level category → subcategory → cooking style)
Multimodal agentic system that guides fine-grained attribute identification by conditioning on coarse-grained predictions in a stepwise manner
Deployable lightweight food recognition system using compact Moondream-2B VLM with hierarchical prompting strategy

title: Housing Potential Common Data Model and City Digital Twin
summary: The evaluation of housing potential requires consideration of a location from multiple perspectives, ranging from zoning and land use to population characteristics and access to services. This research introduces the Housing Potential Common Data Model (HPCDM) to overcome existing data silos, serving as a standard to support integration and interoperability across the diverse range of datasets that are required for housing potential analysis. This report details the evaluation of the model along with the creation of a City Digital Twin for housing and a pilot dashboard application to demonstrate a practical implementation. Beyond the technical framework, this work identifies critical barriers to adoption and provides actionable mitigation strategies for urban planners and stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Housing Potential Common Data Model (HPCDM)，一种用于整合多源异构数据（如分区规划、土地利用、人口特征、服务可达性）的通用数据模型，以支持住房潜力分析。同时构建了城市数字孪生原型和仪表盘应用，并分析了技术采纳障碍与缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 现有住房潜力评估涉及多个维度的数据（如区划、土地利用、人口、服务设施），但这些数据分散在不同系统中形成数据孤岛，缺乏统一标准，导致集成困难、分析效率低。
AI.method: 1. 设计HPCDM通用数据模型，统一多源异构数据的结构和语义；2. 基于HPCDM构建城市数字孪生体；3. 开发仪表盘应用验证模型实用性；4. 识别住房潜力分析中的采纳障碍并提出缓解策略。
AI.result: 成功构建了HPCDM数据模型、城市数字孪生原型及仪表盘应用，验证了跨领域数据整合的可行性，并明确了技术采纳中的关键障碍。

A City Digital Twin architecture specifically designed for housing potential evaluation, built upon the HPCDM data model to enable real-time spatial analysis and visualization.

A systematic framework for identifying adoption barriers and proposing mitigation strategies for implementing HPCDM in urban planning workflows.

title: AgenticRAG: Agentic Retrieval for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
summary: We present AgenticRAG, a practical agentic harness for retrieval and analysis over enterprise knowledge bases. Standard RAG pipelines place significant burden of grounding on the search stack, constraining the language model to a fixed candidate set chosen deep in the retrieval process. Our approach reduces this overdependence by layering a lightweight harness on top of existing enterprise search infrastructure, equipping a reasoning LLM with search, find, open, and summarize tools enabling the model to iteratively retrieve information, navigate within documents, and analyze evidence autonomously. On three open benchmarks we observe substantial gains: $49.6\%$ recall@1 on BRIGHT (+21.8 pp over the best embedding baseline), 0.96 factuality on WixQA ($+13\%$ relative improvement), and $92\%$ answer correctness on FinanceBench--within 2 pp of oracle access to true evidence. Ablation studies show that the most significant factor is the shift from single-shot retrieval to agentic tool use ($5.9\times$ improvement), while multi-query search and in-document navigation contribute to both quality and efficiency. We present various design choices in our agentic harness that were informed by pre-production deployments. Our results demonstrate its suitability for real-world enterprise production environments.

AI.tldr: AgenticRAG 提出了一种轻量级智能体框架，通过在现有企业搜索基础设施上叠加代理工具（搜索、查找、打开、总结），使推理型LLM能够自主迭代检索和分析信息，显著提升RAG在检索召回率、事实性和答案正确性上的性能。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG流程将大量"接地"负担压在搜索堆栈上，将语言模型约束在检索过程深处确定的固定候选集上，导致过度依赖单次检索结果，限制模型能力。
AI.method: 在现有企业搜索基础设施之上叠加轻量级代理框架，为推理型LLM配备搜索、查找、打开和总结四种工具，使模型能够自主迭代检索、在文档内导航并分析证据。
AI.result: BRIGHT上recall@1达49.6%（+21.8pp），WixQA上factuality达0.96（+13%），FinanceBench上答案正确性达92%（与真实证据oracle访问仅差2pp）。从单次检索转向代理工具使用带来5.9倍提升。
AI.conclusion: AgenticRAG通过代理式工具使用而非单次检索，显著提升了RAG系统的性能，验证了其适合企业生产环境。
idea_en: A method for iterative retrieval in RAG systems using an agentic harness with search, find, open, and summarize tools on top of existing enterprise search infrastructure.
A multi-query search mechanism combined with in-document navigation to improve both retrieval quality and efficiency in enterprise RAG systems.
An agentic framework that decouples the language model from being constrained to a fixed candidate set from deep retrieval, enabling autonomous evidence analysis and iterative information gathering.
idea_ch: 一种在现有企业搜索基础设施上叠加代理框架的方法，通过为推理型LLM配备搜索、查找、打开和总结四种工具，实现迭代检索和信息分析。
一种多查询搜索与文档内导航相结合的机制，提高企业RAG系统的检索质量和效率。
一种将语言模型从深度检索确定的固定候选集中解耦的代理式框架，使模型能够自主进行证据分析和迭代信息收集。

title: SPARK: Self-Play with Asymmetric Reward from Knowledge Graphs
summary: Self-play reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with formally verifiable structure, such as mathematics and coding, where both problem generation and reward computation can be grounded in explicit rules. Extending this paradigm to scientific literature is more challenging: the relationships among multi-modal elements within and across documents are rarely made explicit in text, which makes automatic generation of relational reasoning questions difficult and weakens the reliability of reward signals. We propose SPARK (Self-Play with Asymmetric Reward from Knowledge Graphs), a framework that automatically constructs a unified knowledge graph (KG) from multi-document scientific literature and uses it as the structural basis for self-play. KG paths over multimodal nodes serve as a source for generating relational reasoning questions, and structured facts stored in the KG provide a basis for verifiable reward computation. A single small vision-language model (sVLM) alternates between Proposer and Solver roles under information asymmetry against a fixed KG, a design that we believe can be naturally extended toward online adaptation in future work. We evaluate SPARK on public benchmarks and a self-constructed cross-document multi-hop QA dataset. Results show that SPARK consistently outperforms flat-corpus-based self-play baselines, and the performance gap widens as hop count increases, suggesting that KG-structure grounding contributes to relational multi-hop reasoning beyond what unstructured corpus grounding can provide.

AI.tldr: SPARK框架利用知识图谱在多文档科学文献中实现自博弈强化学习，通过结构化路径生成关系推理问题并提供可验证奖励，显著提升多跳推理性能。
AI.motivation: 自博弈强化学习在数学和编码等具有形式化可验证结构的领域表现优异，但将其扩展到科学文献领域面临挑战：文档内和文档间的多模态关系在文本中很少显式表达，导致关系推理问题的自动生成困难且奖励信号可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出SPARK框架：1) 从多文档科学文献自动构建统一知识图谱(KG)；2) 利用KG路径生成关系推理问题；3) 基于KG中的结构化事实提供可验证奖励计算；4) 单个小型视觉语言模型(sVLM)在信息不对称条件下交替扮演Proposer和Solver角色。
AI.result: 在公开基准和自构建的跨文档多跳QA数据集上，SPARK持续优于基于扁平语料库的自博弈基线，且随着跳数增加性能差距扩大。
AI.conclusion: KG结构引导相比非结构化语料引导更能促进关系型多跳推理，该框架可自然扩展至在线自适应场景。
idea_en: A self-play reinforcement learning framework for scientific literature using an automatically constructed unified knowledge graph (KG) that spans multiple documents, enabling relational reasoning question generation from KG paths.
A method for verifiable reward computation in self-play RL by leveraging structured facts stored in a knowledge graph rather than relying on unstructured text.

An asymmetric information architecture where a single small vision-language model (sVLM) alternates between Proposer and Solver roles against a fixed knowledge graph, enabling multi-hop reasoning without human annotation.
A cross-document multi-hop QA dataset construction technique that extracts relational reasoning paths from a unified KG spanning multiple scientific documents.
A KG-grounded question generation system that uses multi-modal node paths in a knowledge graph to automatically create relational reasoning questions with verifiable answers.
idea_ch: 一种基于自动构建的统一知识图谱的自博弈强化学习框架，用于科学文献的关系推理问题生成和可验证奖励计算
一种利用知识图谱中结构化事实进行自博弈奖励计算的方法，替代传统的非结构化文本奖励机制
一种单一小型视觉语言模型在信息不对称条件下交替扮演提议者和求解者角色的架构，固定知识图谱作为客观参考
一种从跨文档统一知识图谱中提取关系推理路径，自动生成多跳问答数据的方法
一种利用知识图谱中多模态节点路径自动生成具有可验证答案的关系推理问题系统

title: Who Prices Cognitive Labor in the Age of Agents? A Position on Compute-Anchored Wages
summary: A natural intuition about the economics of AI agents is that, because agents can be replicated at near-zero marginal cost, they constitute a labor input in infinitely elastic supply, and therefore drive cognitive-labor wages to zero. We argue this framing is wrong in mechanism but partially correct in conclusion, and that the correction matters for both theory and policy. \textbf{Agents are not labor; they are a production technology that converts compute capital $K_c$ into effective units of cognitive labor $L_A$.} Once this is recognized, the elastic-supply margin that anchors the equilibrium wage migrates from the labor market to the compute capital market. Building on the textbook factor-pricing framework \citep{mankiw2020}, we derive a \emph{Compute-Anchored Wage} (CAW) bound stating that, on tasks where human and agent cognitive labor are substitutes, the competitive human wage is bounded above by $λ\cdot k \cdot r_c$, where $r_c$ is the rental rate of compute capital, $k$ is the compute intensity of one effective agent-labor unit, and $λ$ is the relative human-to-agent productivity. We generalize the result through CES aggregation, separate substitutable from complementary tasks (yielding a directional inversion of skill-biased technical change), and discuss factor-share consequences. The position is concise: \emph{the price-setter for cognitive labor is no longer the labor market.}

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI智能体不是劳动力，而是将计算资本转化为有效认知劳动的生产技术。由此推导出"计算锚定工资"（CAW）上限：在可替代任务中，人类工资受限于计算资本租金率、计算强度和人机相对生产率三者的乘积。核心结论是：认知劳动的定价者已不再是劳动力市场。
AI.motivation: 挑战"AI智能体因零边际复制成本而无限供给，从而将认知劳动工资压至零"这一直觉，指出其机制错误但结论部分正确。作者认为将智能体视为劳动力是错误的，应将其视为一种生产技术，这一修正对理论和政策都有重要意义。
AI.method: 基于标准教科书要素定价框架（Mankiw 2020），将AI智能体建模为将计算资本K_c转化为有效认知劳动单位L_A的生产技术。推导出"计算锚定工资"（CAW）边界：在人类与智能体可替代的任务上，竞争性人类工资上限为λ·k·r_c。进一步通过CES聚合推广结论，区分可替代任务与互补任务。
AI.result: 提出了计算锚定工资（CAW）理论，证明人类工资上限由计算资本市场决定而非劳动力市场。在可替代任务中，工资上限为λ·k·r_c；在互补任务中则出现技能偏向性技术变化的反向逆转。讨论了要素份额的后果。
AI.conclusion: 认知劳动的定价者已从劳动力市场转移到计算资本市场。AI智能体作为生产技术的重新框架化改变了我们对工资决定机制的理解，对劳动经济学和AI政策设计有重要影响。
idea_en: A method for determining a wage ceiling for human cognitive labor in tasks substitutable by AI agents, wherein the wage ceiling is computed as a product of a human-to-agent relative productivity factor, a compute intensity parameter per effective agent-labor unit, and a rental rate of compute capital.

A compute-anchored wage (CAW) model that re-frames AI agents not as labor supply but as a production technology that converts compute capital into effective cognitive labor units, shifting the price-setting mechanism from labor markets to compute capital markets.

A system for classifying cognitive tasks into substitutable versus complementary categories relative to AI agents, and applying different wage determination rules based on the category, including a directional inversion of skill-biased technical change for complementary tasks.
idea_ch: 一种确定与AI智能体可替代的人类认知劳动工资上限的方法，其中工资上限由人机相对生产率因子、每有效智能体劳动单位的计算强度参数和计算资本租金率的乘积计算得出。
一种计算锚定工资（CAW）模型，将AI智能体重构为将计算资本转化为有效认知劳动单位的生产技术，而非劳动力供给，从而将定价机制从劳动力市场转移到计算资本市场。
一种将认知任务分为与AI智能体可替代类和互补类的分类系统，并根据分类应用不同的工资决定规则，包括互补类任务中技能偏向性技术变化的反向逆转。

title: BitCal-TTS: Bit-Calibrated Test-Time Scaling for Quantized Reasoning Models
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproducibility materials at https://github.com/Saibabu7770/bitcal-tts
summary:
Post-training quantization makes large reasoning models practical under tight memory and latency budgets, but it can distort the online signals that drive adaptive test-time compute allocation. Under a fixed cap on the number of newly generated tokens, miscalibrated confidence can lead to harmful early halting: the model may surface a plausible final line while the underlying reasoning is still wrong, or the controller may stop before the trace has stabilized. We study this interaction for greedy 4-bit inference and propose BitCal-TTS, a lightweight runtime controller that combines (i) inexpensive online proxies for token-level uncertainty and reasoning-trace stability, (ii) a bit-conditioned confidence rescaling that is conservative at low nominal precision, and (iii) a bit-aware post-marker confirmation horizon designed for GSM8K-style structured outputs. The method requires no fine-tuning of the base model and integrates with standard Hugging Face 4-bit inference using forward hooks for logits and last-layer hidden states.
  On small evaluation shards of GSM8K with Qwen2.5 Instruct models, BitCal-TTS improves exact-match accuracy over a non-bit-aware adaptive baseline at the 7B and 14B scales while preserving substantial token savings relative to fixed-budget decoding. At a token cap of B=512, on the evaluation shards we report (N=54 for 7B and N=35 for 14B; not the full GSM8K test set), accuracy gains are +3.7 points (7B) and +2.8 points (14B), with the premature-stop rate falling from 14.8% to 11.1% on 7B and from 17.1% to 11.4% on 14B. We report Wilson 95% confidence intervals throughout and explicitly discuss the limited statistical power of the partial-shard comparisons. We release code and figure-generation scripts to support full reproduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BitCal-TTS，一种轻量级运行时控制器，通过在线不确定性代理、比特条件置信度重缩放和比特感知确认视野，缓解4-bit量化推理中因置信度失准导致的过早停止问题，无需微调即可提升GSM8K上的准确率并节省token。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化在降低大模型推理内存和延迟时，会扭曲自适应测试时计算分配的在线信号，导致模型在推理仍错误时过早输出看似合理的最终答案。
AI.method: BitCal-TTS结合三种技术：(i) token级不确定性和推理轨迹稳定性的低成本在线代理；(ii) 在低位宽下保持保守的比特条件置信度重缩放；(iii) 针对GSM8K结构化输出的比特感知后标记确认视野。通过forward hooks集成到标准Hugging Face 4-bit推理中。
AI.result: 在GSM8K小规模评估上，7B模型准确率提升+3.7点，14B提升+2.8点；7B模型过早停止率从14.8%降至11.1%，14B从17.1%降至11.4%。
AI.conclusion: BitCal-TTS在不微调模型的情况下，有效缓解了量化推理中的过早停止问题，兼顾准确率和token节省。
idea_en: A bit-conditioned confidence rescaling mechanism that dynamically adjusts model confidence estimates based on the quantization precision (e.g., 4-bit vs 8-bit), applying conservative scaling at low nominal precision to prevent premature halting during adaptive test-time compute allocation.

A lightweight runtime controller (BitCal-TTS) that integrates online proxies for token-level uncertainty and reasoning-trace stability to detect and mitigate harmful early stopping in quantized large language models.

A bit-aware post-marker confirmation horizon method designed for structured outputs (e.g., GSM8K-style chain-of-thought reasoning), which enforces a minimum number of tokens after a final answer marker before allowing early termination.

A system that combines (i) online token-level uncertainty proxies, (ii) bit-conditioned confidence rescaling, and (iii) bit-aware confirmation horizon into a forward-hook-based integration with Hugging Face 4-bit inference, requiring no fine-tuning of the base model.
idea_ch: 一种比特条件置信度重缩放机制，根据量化精度动态调整模型置信度估计，在低位宽下应用保守缩放，防止自适应测试时计算分配中的过早停止。
一种轻量级运行时控制器BitCal-TTS，集成token级不确定性和推理轨迹稳定性的在线代理，用于检测和缓解量化大模型中的有害过早停止。
一种针对结构化输出设计的比特感知后标记确认视野方法，在最终答案标记后强制执行最小token数，才允许提前终止推理。
一种将在线token级不确定性代理、比特条件置信度重缩放和比特感知确认视野相结合的系统，通过forward hooks集成到Hugging Face 4-bit推理中，无需微调基础模型。

title: Nonsense Helps: Prompt Space Perturbation Broadens Reasoning Exploration
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, in complex tasks, GRPO frequently suffers from the ``zero-advantage problem'': when all sampled rollouts for a query fail, the relative advantage collapses to zero. Consequently, the model loses effective training signals for these questions, wasting the training data and computational budget. While simply increasing the sampling budget for these questions is a common remedy, the static sampling policy inherently constrains reasoning exploration, limiting the success rate. In this paper, we propose Lorem Perturbation for Exploration (LoPE), a simple yet effective training framework to break this exploration bottleneck. We posit that task-irrelevant prompt-space perturbations can shift the model's output distribution enough to unlock orthogonal reasoning pathways for hard questions. Specifically, LoPE prepends sequences stochastically assembled from Lorem Ipsum vocabulary (a pseudo-Latin placeholder text) to the prompts before resampling. Experiments across 1.7B, 4B, and 7B models demonstrate that LoPE significantly outperforms resampling with the original prompts. Further analysis reveals that other Latin-based random sequences with low perplexity are also effective perturbations. Our results establish LoPE as a strong baseline for broadening exploration in LLM reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoPE（Lorem Perturbation for Exploration）框架，通过在提示词前添加随机Lorem Ipsum占位文本扰动，解决GRPO在复杂任务中因所有采样结果失败导致的"零优势问题"，从而解锁新的推理路径，提升LLM强化学习中的探索效率。
AI.motivation: GRPO在复杂任务中常因所有采样均失败而出现"零优势问题"，导致模型无法获得有效训练信号，浪费数据和计算资源。简单增加采样数量受限于静态采样策略，探索效率低。
AI.method: LoPE在重新采样前，向提示词前随机添加由Lorem Ipsum词汇（伪拉丁占位文本）随机拼接的序列，通过任务无关的提示空间扰动改变模型输出分布，解锁正交推理路径。
AI.result: 在1.7B、4B和7B模型上的实验表明，LoPE显著优于使用原始提示词重新采样。其他低困惑度的拉丁随机序列也有效。
AI.conclusion: LoPE是一种简单有效的基线方法，可拓宽LLM强化学习中的探索空间。
idea_en: Method for enhancing exploration in reinforcement learning for LLMs by prepending task-irrelevant stochastic perturbations (e.g., Lorem Ipsum text) to prompts before resampling, to overcome zero-advantage problem in GRPO.
System for generating orthogonal reasoning paths by inserting pseudo-Latin placeholder sequences into LLM prompts during training, altering output distribution without changing task semantics.
Adaptive resampling technique for GRPO that applies low-perplexity Latin-based random perturbations to prompts to unlock failed reasoning trajectories.
Training framework that combines GRPO with prompt-space perturbation to provide effective learning signals even when all initial rollouts fail for a given query.
idea_ch: 一种通过在提示词前添加任务无关的随机扰动（如Lorem Ipsum文本）来增强LLM强化学习探索的方法，解决GRPO中的零优势问题
通过向LLM提示中插入伪拉丁占位序列生成正交推理路径的系统，在不改变任务语义的情况下改变模型输出分布
结合低困惑度拉丁随机序列的GRPO自适应重采样技术，为失败推理轨迹解锁新的探索路径
将GRPO与提示空间扰动相结合的训练框架，即使在初始所有采样均失败的情况下也能提供有效训练信号

title: Locality-aware Private Class Identification for Domain Adaptation with Extreme Label Shift
summary: Domain adaptation aims to transfer knowledge from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain with different distributions. In real-world scenarios, the label spaces of the two domains often have an inclusion relationship, where some classes exist only in one domain but not the other. These non-overlapping classes are referred to as private classes. Identifying private class samples and mitigating their adverse effects is critical in the literature. Existing methods rely on the assumption that shifts in private classes are large enough to be considered outliers. However, the variance within a single shared class can be significantly larger than the difference between a private class and another shared class, challenging this assumption. Consequently, private classes substantially increase the difficulty of cross-domain classification. To address these issues, based on local transportation and metric properties of optimal transport (OT), a locality-aware private class identification approach is proposed in the form of a score function on transport mass. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is theoretically proven, highlighting the score function's strong ability to distinguish between shared and private class samples. Building on this, we introduce a reliable OT-based method (ReOT) for domain adaptation under severe label shift. ReOT minimizes classification risk while learning the separated cluster structure between the identified shared classes and private classes, effectively avoiding mismatch between shared-private sample pairs, thus ensuring that important knowledge is reliably transported intra-class to mitigate class-conditional discrepancy. Furthermore, a generalization upper bound of the target risk is provided for extreme label shift scenarios, which can be minimized by ReOT. Extensive experiments on benchmarks validate the effectiveness of ReOT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于最优传输的局部感知私有类识别方法ReOT，解决域适应中标签空间包含关系下的私有类识别与分布对齐问题，通过传输质量评分函数区分共享/私有类，并可靠地传输知识以避免错配。
AI.motivation: 现有域适应方法假设私有类与共享类差异足够大以被视为异常值，但现实中共享类内部方差可能远大于私有类与共享类之间的差异，导致该假设失效。私有类样本的存在严重增加了跨域分类难度，亟需一种能可靠识别私有类并减少其负面影响的方法。

title: AlphaCrafter: A Full-Stack Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
summary: Financial markets are inherently non-stationary, driven by complex interactions among macroeconomic regimes, microstructural frictions, and behavioral dynamics. Building quantitative strategies that remain profitable demands the continuous coupling of factor discovery, regime-adaptive selection, and risk-constrained execution. Prevailing approaches, however, optimize these components under static or isolated assumptions. Factor mining frameworks typically treat alpha discovery as a one-time search process, implicitly assuming that factor efficacy persists across market regimes. Execution-oriented systems often adopt role-playing agent architectures that simulate anthropomorphic trading committees, introducing behavioral noise rather than systematic rationality. Consequently, a fully automated, rationality-driven framework unifying a coherent quantitative pipeline remains absent. We introduce AlphaCrafter, a full-stack multi-agent framework that closes this gap through a continuously adaptive factor-to-execution pipeline, designed to track and respond to evolving market conditions without manual intervention. AlphaCrafter operates via three specialized agents: a Miner that continuously expands the factor pool via LLM-guided search, a Screener that assesses prevailing market conditions to construct regime-conditioned factor ensembles, and a Trader that translates these ensembles into quantitative strategies under explicit risk constraints. Together, these three agents form a closed-loop cross-sectional trading system that adapts holistically to evolving market dynamics. Extensive experiments on CSI 300 and S&P 500 demonstrate that AlphaCrafter consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in risk-adjusted returns while exhibiting the lowest cross-trial variance, confirming that integrated and adaptive factor-to-execution design yields robust trading performance.

AI.tldr: AlphaCrafter是一个全栈多智能体框架，通过三个专业化智能体（Miner、Screener、Trader）实现从因子挖掘到交易执行的闭环自适应流程，在非平稳金融市场上持续获得优于现有方法的风险调整收益。

AI.result: 在沪深300和标普500上的实验表明，AlphaCrafter在风险调整收益上持续优于最先进的基线方法，并且跨试验方差最低，验证了集成自适应因子到执行设计的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 集成且自适应的因子到执行设计能够产生稳健的交易性能，填补了全自动、理性驱动的统一量化流程的空白。

title: Belief Memory: Agent Memory Under Partial Observability
summary: LLM agents that operate over long context depend on external memory to accumulate knowledge over time. However, existing methods typically store each observation as a single deterministic conclusion (e.g., inferring "API~X failed" from temporary errors), even though such observations are inherently partial and potentially ambiguous. By committing to one conclusion and discarding uncertainty, these methods introduce self-reinforcing error: the agent acts on the stored conclusion, never revisits alternatives, and reinforces the conclusion over time. To address this issue, we propose BeliefMem, which shifts the memory paradigm from committing to a single conclusion per observation to retaining multiple candidate conclusions with their probabilities. Concretely, BeliefMem stores the candidate conclusions as separate memory entries, each carrying a probability that is updated via Noisy-OR rules as new observations arrive. At retrieval, all candidates surface together with their probabilities, keeping alternatives visible to the agent. Since each conclusion in memory retains its probability, BeliefMem preserves the uncertainty that the deterministic paradigm discards, enabling the agent to act with high confidence on well-evidenced knowledge while retaining the capacity to update its confidence when new evidence arrives. Empirical evaluations on LoCoMo and ALFWorld benchmarks show that, even with limited data, BeliefMem achieves the best average performance, remarkably outperforming well-known baselines. More broadly, such probabilistic memory produces substantial gains and explores a new direction for agent memory in partially observable environments.

AI.tldr: BeliefMem提出了一种概率记忆范式，将每个观测存储为多个候选结论及其概率，而非单一确定性结论，通过Noisy-OR规则更新概率，在长上下文LLM代理中保留不确定性，从而避免自强化错误。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的外部记忆方法将每个观测存储为单一确定性结论，忽略了观测的局部性和模糊性，导致自强化错误——代理基于存储的结论行动，从不重新审视替代方案，并随时间强化错误结论。
AI.method: BeliefMem将每个观测存储为多个候选结论（各自作为独立记忆条目），每个结论携带一个概率；概率通过Noisy-OR规则随新观测到达而更新；检索时所有候选结论及其概率一同呈现给代理。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和ALFWorld基准测试上，即使数据有限，BeliefMem实现了最佳平均性能，显著优于知名基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 概率记忆范式在部分可观测环境中为代理记忆探索了新方向，通过保留不确定性使代理能在高置信度证据上果断行动，同时保留根据新证据更新置信度的能力。

title: Causal Probing for Internal Visual Representations in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Despite the remarkable success of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across diverse tasks, the internal mechanisms governing how they encode and ground distinct visual concepts remain poorly understood. To bridge this gap, we propose a causal framework based on activation steering to actively probe and manipulate internal visual representations. Through systematic intervention across four visual concept categories, our results reveal a divergence in concept encoding: entities exhibit distinct localized memorization, whereas abstract concepts are globally distributed across the network. Critically, this divergence uncovers a mechanistic driver of scaling laws: increasing model depth is indispensable for encoding distributed and complex abstract concepts, whereas entity localization remains remarkably invariant to scale. Furthermore, reverse steering uncovers that blocking explicit output triggers a surge in latent activations, exposing a compensatory mechanism between perception and generation. Finally, extending our analysis to visual reasoning, we expose a disconnect between perception and reasoning although MLLMs successfully recognize geometric relations, they treat them merely as static visual features, failing to trigger the procedural execution necessary for abstract problem-solving.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果干预框架研究多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)内部视觉概念编码机制，发现实体概念呈现局部记忆化而抽象概念全局分布，并揭示了缩放定律的机械驱动力、感知与生成之间的补偿机制，以及视觉推理中感知与推理的脱节现象。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在各种任务上取得显著成功，但其内部如何编码和接地不同视觉概念的机制尚不清楚。现有研究缺乏对内部视觉表征的主动探测和操控手段。
AI.method: 提出基于激活引导(activation steering)的因果框架，通过系统性干预四类视觉概念(实体与抽象)，操纵内部视觉表征来探测编码机制。
AI.result: 实体概念呈局部记忆化；抽象概念全局分布；模型深度增加对抽象概念编码至关重要；阻断显式输出会引发潜在激活激增(补偿机制)；视觉推理中感知与推理脱节。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了MLLMs内部视觉概念编码的差异性机制，发现了缩放定律的机械根源，以及感知与生成、感知与推理之间的复杂关系。

A method for identifying localized vs. distributed encoding patterns of visual concepts through systematic causal interventions

title: Prober.ai: Gated Inquiry-Based Feedback via LLM-Constrained Personas for Argumentative Writing Development
comment: Prototype awarded second place at the NYEdTech Hackathon (March 2026) https://www.nyedtechhackathon.com/2026-submissions
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in educational settings has paradoxically undermined the cognitive processes they purport to support. Students increasingly outsource critical thinking to AI assistants that generate polished text on demand, resulting in measurable cognitive debt and diminished argumentative reasoning skills. We present Prober.ai, a web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm: rather than generating or rewriting student text, the system constrains an LLM (Gemini 3 Flash Preview) through persona-specific system prompts and structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions about argumentative weaknesses. A two-phase interaction architecture -- Challenge and Unlock -- implements a pedagogical friction mechanism whereby revision suggestions are gated behind mandatory student reflection. The system's design is grounded in Toulmin's argumentation theory, research on peer feedforward questioning mechanisms, and evidence on AI-supported feedback in writing instruction. A functional prototype was developed in 36 hours during the NY EdTech Hackathon (March 2026), where it was awarded second place. We describe the system architecture, the prompt engineering methodology for constraining LLM output to pedagogically aligned JSON schemas, and discuss implications for scalable, cognition-preserving AI integration in writing education.

AI.motivation: LLM在教育中的广泛应用导致学生将批判性思维外包给AI，产生认知债务（cognitive debt）和论证推理能力下降，现有AI辅导范式（直接生成或改写文本）反而加剧了这一问题。

AI.result: 在NY EdTech Hackathon（2026年3月）的36小时内开发出功能原型，并获得第二名。

title: Text-Graph Synergy: A Bidirectional Verification and Completion Framework for RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a core paradigm for enhancing factual grounding and multi-hop reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional text-based RAG often retrieves logically irrelevant pseudo-evidence, while graph-based RAG is frequently hindered by search-time pruning, which may discard potentially valid reasoning paths. Existing hybrid approaches primarily adopt simple evidence concatenation or unidirectional enhancement, which fails to address the fundamental "Information Island" problem caused by asymmetric reasoning flows between unstructured text and structured graphs. We propose \textbf{TGS-RAG}, a unified framework for \textbf{T}ext-\textbf{G}raph \textbf{S}ynergistic enhancement. TGS-RAG introduces a bidirectional mechanism: (i) a \textbf{Graph-to-Text} channel that employs a Global Voting strategy from visited graph nodes to re-rank and refine textual evidence, filtering out semantic noise; and (ii) a \textbf{Text-to-Graph} channel that utilizes the \textbf{Memory-based Orphan Entity Bridging} algorithm. This algorithm utilizes textual cues to proactively resurrect valid but previously pruned reasoning paths from the search history without additional database overhead. Experimental results on multiple multi-hop reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that TGS-RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a superior balance between retrieval precision and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: TGS-RAG提出了一种文本-图双向协同增强的RAG框架，通过全局投票策略和记忆型孤儿实体桥接算法，解决了非对称推理流导致的信息孤岛问题，在多跳推理任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统文本RAG检索到逻辑无关的伪证据，图RAG在搜索时剪枝可能丢弃有效推理路径，现有混合方法仅采用简单拼接或单向增强，无法解决非对称推理流导致的"信息孤岛"问题。
AI.method: 提出TGS-RAG统一框架，包含双向机制：1) Graph-to-Text通道：通过已访问图节点的全局投票策略重新排序和精炼文本证据，过滤语义噪声；2) Text-to-Graph通道：采用基于记忆的孤儿实体桥接算法，利用文本线索主动恢复搜索历史中有效但被剪枝的推理路径，无需额外数据库开销。
AI.result: 在多个多跳推理基准测试上，TGS-RAG显著优于最先进基线，在检索精度和计算效率之间取得了优越的平衡。
AI.conclusion: TGS-RAG通过文本-图双向协同增强有效解决了信息孤岛问题，为RAG系统提供了一种更高效的推理路径恢复与噪声过滤机制。
idea_en: A bidirectional text-graph synergistic enhancement framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation, featuring a Graph-to-Text channel with Global Voting strategy that re-ranks and refines textual evidence based on visited graph nodes to filter semantic noise.

A Memory-based Orphan Entity Bridging algorithm for Text-to-Graph channel that proactively resurrects valid but previously pruned reasoning paths from search history using textual cues, without requiring additional database overhead.

A unified RAG framework that addresses the Information Island problem caused by asymmetric reasoning flows between unstructured text and structured graphs through bidirectional cross-modal interaction.

title: Retrieval-Conditioned Topology Selection with Provable Budget Conservation for Multi-Agent Code Generation
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track Submission Under review
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems for code generation face a fundamental routing problem: the optimal orchestration topology depends on the structural complexity of the code under modification, yet existing systems select topologies without consulting the codebase. We present Retrieval-Guided Adaptive Orchestration (RGAO), an architecture that closes this loop by extracting a structural complexity vector from a hierarchical code index before selecting the orchestration topology. RGAO operates within Code-Agent, a multi-agent framework whose sub-agents are governed by formal contracts with six-dimensional budget vectors. Our headline contribution is the composition of two previously separate lines of work -- complexity-conditioned LLM routing and formal resource algebras -- yielding a property neither admits alone: provable budget conservation under retrieval-conditioned dynamic topology selection. Concretely we contribute: (1) a complexity-conditioned topology router that reduces proxy-measured misrouting from 30.1% to 8.2%; (2) a budget algebra with a structural-induction conservation theorem; and (3) a hierarchical code retrieval engine. Empirical evaluation demonstrates sub-millisecond DAG construction and linear tree-index scalability.

AI.tldr: RGAO是一种检索引导的自适应编排架构，通过从分层代码索引提取结构复杂度向量来动态选择多智能体LLM系统的最佳编排拓扑，解决了代码生成中的路由问题，将误路由率从30.1%降至8.2%，并实现了预算守恒定理。
AI.motivation: 现有面向代码生成的多智能体LLM系统在选择编排拓扑结构时未考虑待修改代码的结构复杂度，导致路由问题——最优拓扑取决于代码结构复杂度，但现有系统盲目选择拓扑。
AI.method: RGAO架构包含三个核心组件：(1) 复杂度条件拓扑路由器，从分层代码索引提取结构复杂度向量；(2) 预算代数系统，含结构归纳守恒定理；(3) 分层代码检索引擎。在Code-Agent多智能体框架中运行，子智能体受六维预算向量约束的正式契约管理。
AI.result: 将代理测量的误路由率从30.1%降至8.2%；实现亚毫秒级DAG构建和线性树索引扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 首次将复杂度条件的LLM路由与形式资源代数相结合，实现了在检索条件下动态拓扑选择中的可证明预算守恒，这是两者单独都无法实现的特性。
